- **Step 2 (deliberate deferral — optional secondary keepalive)**: Issue #4725 lists an OPTIONAL, defense-in-depth Python-driver keepalive in `plan-review run` / `design-step3-review.sh` to dampen the linear base notifications, explicitly labeled "Mitigation only; do not rely on it" and "never the primary mechanism." Not implemented. **Why:** the primary mechanically-enforced fix (deny the amplifying background recovery waiter; force the foreground non-sleeping probe) fully removes the exploding cost source. The foreground-probe-only recovery path is self-sustaining for correctness — the bounded linear base notifications keep firing cheap synchronous probes until the terminal sentinel appears — so the keepalive affects only notification *count*, not correctness. Adding a new keepalive emitter is net-new risk on a load-bearing review driver for marginal cost benefit, against simplicity-first. Recorded here, not filed as a tracked issue, because it is a deliberate non-implementation of an explicitly-optional plan item.
